# Customers C001 and C002, each with the guid it states.
#
# The guids are stated so a `lot_owner:` in another fixture can state one
# customer's ID beside the other's guid.
#
# What this fixture produces: customer C001, guid c1c1…, and customer C002,
# guid c2c2….
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_lot_owner_stating_two_customers_is_refused.py.
customer "C001"
	guid: "c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

customer "C002"
	guid: "c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2"
	name: "Beta"
	currency: CAD
